basic_details.job_title: CUSAT Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) has notified 1 vacancy for the Technician Grade II post on a contract basis for an initial period of one year. Candidates applying for the post must possess an ITI Certificate in Electrical/Electronics along with two years of experience in Engineering Colleges or Universities, and meet the age limit of 18 - 40 Years as on 1 January 2026. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 25,980. application_fee.details: The application fee must be remitted through online payment using Net banking or Credit/Debit cards of almost all banks. Payment by Cheque or DD will not be accepted.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the post is 18 - 40 Years as on 01.01.2026. Backward communities and SC/ST candidates are eligible for usual age relaxation as per rules.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification & Experience Technician Grade II ITI Certificate in Electrical/Electronics and two years’ experience in Engineering Colleges/University.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates must apply online through the official CUSAT website recruit.cusat.ac.in on or before 16-11-2026.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and sign the hard copy.
Enclose copies of required documents to prove age, qualifications, and other credentials.
Dispatch the signed hard copy of the application along with enclosures to the “Registrar, Administrative Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi-22” on or before 23-11-2026.
Ensure the envelope is superscribed with the text “Application for the post of Technician Grade II, Department of Polymer Science & Rubber Technology on contract basis”.
important_instructions: Late and defective applications will summarily be rejected by the University. Payment made through Cheque or Demand Draft (DD) will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates must ensure that the envelope containing the hard copy is correctly superscribed as instructed in the notification. Engagement is subject to breaks during the vacation months of May and June of each year.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates wishing to apply for the post of Technician Grade II must satisfy the specific educational qualifications, experience criteria, and age limits prescribed in the official notification. The age limit for the post is 18 - 40 Years as on 01.01.2026. Backward communities and SC/ST candidates are eligible for usual age relaxation as per rules.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: ITI Certificate in Electrical/Electronics and two years’ experience in Engineering Colleges/University.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,980/- per month. The engagement is on a contract basis from July to April with breaks during the vacation months of May and June of the respective year. The initial period of appointment is for one year, which may be extended up to two years. The appointment, conditions of service, emoluments, and other service benefits are governed by the provisions of KSR, KS&SSR, Act/Statutes/Ordinances, and Syndicate Decisions of Cochin University of Science and Technology as amended from time to time. content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be remitted through online payment using Net banking or Credit/Debit cards of almost all banks. Payment by Cheque or DD will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUSAT Technician Grade II
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must apply online through the official CUSAT website recruit.cusat.ac.in on or before 16-11-2026. Take a printout of the submitted application form and sign the hard copy. Enclose copies of required documents to prove age, qualifications, and other credentials. Dispatch the signed hard copy of the application along with enclosures to the “Registrar, Administrative Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi-22” on or before 23-11-2026. Ensure the envelope is superscribed with the text “Application for the post of Technician Grade II, Department of Polymer Science & Rubber Technology on contract basis”.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Shortlisting
content_sections.text: The University reserves the right to shortlist the candidates on the basis of marks obtained in the qualifying degree. Reservation rules are applicable for the appointment to the above post.

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Signed Hard Copy

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Late and defective applications will summarily be rejected by the University. Payment made through Cheque or Demand Draft (DD) will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates must ensure that the envelope containing the hard copy is correctly superscribed as instructed in the notification. Engagement is subject to breaks during the vacation months of May and June of each year.
